CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Morph between shapes on the beat. Turn this off to take manual control over the shapes.
CONTROLS.NAME: morph_on_beat

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sets the shape to a random new shape
CONTROLS.NAME: random_shape

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Increase the shape size when the bass hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: shape_grow_on_beat

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blur the edges of the shapes.
CONTROLS.NAME: shape_blur

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How quickly to morph between shapes.
CONTROLS.NAME: morph_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: the minimum number of frames to hold each shape. raise this to prevent rapid changes
CONTROLS.NAME: shape_min_duration

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Switch to the chosen shape when selected. Note that this doesn't always represent the currently visible shape.
CONTROLS.NAME: pick_shape

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scatter the designs out into little dots
CONTROLS.NAME: scatter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Invert the colors on the beat
CONTROLS.NAME: invert_on_beat

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change this to pick a color palette
CONTROLS.NAME: palette_picker

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: this scene adds some little twinkly stars based on the audio, toggle this to prevent that
CONTROLS.NAME: reactive_stars

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: this scene adds some little burst animations based on the audio, toggle this to prevent that
CONTROLS.NAME: reactive_bursts

DESCRIPTION: Smoothly morphing 2D shapes with reactive elements that join based on the music. Clean black and white or pick a sound reactive color palette.
TITLE: Shape Shifter
